description_en: Uploads the digest information of phase data to the blockchain after IoT device signing, and optionally binds associated data from other phases
description_zh: 通过IoT设备签名后，上传阶段数据的摘要信息到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据
kebab_example: aliyun ltl upload-mpcos-phase-digest-info-by-device --biz-api-version 1.0.0 --biz-chain-id 4899730875490000 --phase-group-id 3838607922870000 --phase-id 6442088875110000 --data-key 32bfce96b4e2f9bec0f2ea5cc2f14ace1486cc146d5832d3a84e5332fe890000 --phase-data ebf44d78ae75288d7d0057a5ebf44d78a6b86d04502dcbda643c4d24ff2a0000 --iot-auth-type ID2 --iot-id 1833297615720000 --iot-id-source 2 --iot-id-service-provider g9R4ghe0000 --iot-data-digest 94894989498FDDABD51698BD1A49BF1AFB0AA94FAA8DB65A689164BEED000000 --iot-signature '2~2~192ADFB498AA0000~1579198300000~J8E891NAgAhwHBHm8000000/hnswr698HSb09ahS8709bn9s03jg98u4jg000000' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadMPCoSPhaseDigestInfoByDevice

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the data
parameters.name: data_key

parameters.help_en:
The digest of the IoT trusted data value.
